scope: Bounded class-enriched multinational development subset; not a representative road survey
limitations: Country/view labels only; Indian states not established.
Class-enriched sampling changes prevalence; internal metrics describe this subset.
Filename blocks, exact pixels and close thumbnails group identifiable related scenes, not proven route-disjointness.
No official unlabelled test images are used. No universal accuracy claim.
holdout_policy: Old training groups remain training; previously exposed validation/test groups become validation. Final test contains only newly collected groups without identified connections to any old image.
